title: Chess Worker capabilities
description: What the Worker does besides serving files.

entities.name: Signed-in game
entities.description: The game only for players signed in to icelander.net.
entities.responsibility: Checks icelander.net's sign-in through the login service on every request, maps the person to Gambit's own player by the first of their addresses Gambit knows, and sends sign-in and sign-out to the host's.
access: The page: signed in with the games:play role.
The API: anyone signed in; /api/me answers everyone.
auth/dev: only with DEV_LOGIN "1" on a local host.

entities.name: Invitations by email
entities.description: Invitations to an address, answered once.
entities.responsibility: Stores an invitation to an email address, emails it when Resend is set up, and lets the addressee accept or decline and the sender cancel, once.
access: Accept and decline: the player whose address it was sent to. Cancel: its sender. Look at it: either.
At most 30 invitations per player per hour.

entities.name: Refereed online games
entities.description: Online games the server checks and broadcasts.
entities.responsibility: Runs each online game's actions one at a time in its Durable Object, checks them with chess.js, saves the game and its transcript, and sends the new game to both players.
access: Only the game's two players may see it, act in it or watch it live.

entities.name: Contacts and history
entities.description: Who a player has played, and every finished game.
entities.responsibility: Lists a player's contacts with their record against each, the games between two players, the finished games, and stores finished games against the computer after replaying them.
access: Signed in; a player sees only games they played.

entities.name: Profile pictures from this origin
entities.description: Players' pictures, fetched by the Worker.
entities.responsibility: Keeps only Google's and GitHub's picture addresses, and serves them from the game's own origin.
access: Signed in; any player's picture by their id.
